PEEPEstat,RS sets PEEP at the lowest static elastance of the respiratory system, i.e. best-compliance PEEP, a comparator strategy DeepSeek omitted.

The decremental PEEP trial is the procedure that locates the lowest-Estat,RS PEEP, not a separate strategy applied to patients; coding it too double-counts one comparator (both reviewers code the same group's Cstat strategy in boesing_2024a as best_compliance_peep only).

What GLM lists as missing (demographics, Ptpexp target table, Tables S4-S9) is in the published Additional file 1, and the remaining gaps are figure-only values; nothing requires contacting the authors.

Measurements were made in one session once consent was obtained; timing is known only relative to study entry, which the codebook codes as enrolment (timing_subgroup stays unclear, as both have).

ptp_target_subgroups lists transpulmonary-pressure target strategies; the ARDSNet table and lowest-Estat,RS strategies are not Ptp targets, so adding 'other' would place the study in a subgroup it does not belong to.
